description: Job vacancies from EURES, the EU job mobility portal (public employment services of EU/EEA countries): title, employer, country and NUTS region, working time, contract kind, number of posts, ad languages, EURES flag (open to foreign applicants), ESCO codes, description extract, created date and link. Keyword search, optional country, newest first or best match; plus total count. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
